messages:
Julia Chen: Heads-up — Satori's Field CTO wants our SOC 2 Type II artifact plus a signed NDA before legal will greenlight the SOW. They're tight on timing.
Samir Patel: We should avoid sending the full report without NDA. Recommend: mutual NDA + redacted SOC2 PDF OR an attestation/bridge-letter that summarizes scope and period.
Devon Reyes: We have an attestation template in security. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/security/attestations/attestation_template_v3.docx. We can also provide a CAIQ extract for their vendor-risk team.
Marta Lopez: Customer asked for "signed attestation or SOC2" within 30 days to proceed. Can we promise attestation + redacted report within that window?
Priya Singh: Legal is OK with an attestation but needs a Jira intake (LEGAL-4321). NDA: use Mutual NDA v3. Full SOC2 only after NDA countersigned and security redaction review. Expect ~3 business days once legal intake is submitted.
Samir Patel: Opening LEGAL-4321 now and attaching the customer's request. Quick Q: can we redact the audit firm name?
Devon Reyes: We typically do not redact the auditor unless there's a specific reason. Redact customer PII and any third-party identifiers that aren't relevant. Attestation will state the report period (e.g., Jan 1 2023 - Dec 31 2023) and high-level control posture.
security-bot: Notice: SOC 2 Type II (period: Jan 1 2023 - Dec 31 2023) Redacted copy available in secure drive. Attestation template v3 uploaded.
Julia Chen: I'll tell Satori: 1) sign NDA link; 2) after NDA, we can provide a redacted SOC2 + signed attestation; 3) CAIQ export available if needed. Timeline: attestation ~3 business days after legal intake. Any objections?
Priya Singh: No objections. Legal wants the attestation to include a clause: "no material control exceptions identified subsequent to the report period to the best of our knowledge". Also no audit workpapers to be shared. We'll draft language.
Marta Lopez: They also want a short POC data-residency note (US-only) for the SOW. Can we add a POC line about ephemeral data handling?
Samir Patel: Draft SOW snippet: ```POC data residency: US-region only; demo inputs masked; retention <=7 days; telemetry limited to anonymized performance metrics.```
Julia Chen: Sounds good. I'll send the NDA link now and set expectations. Samir 11 once LEGAL-4321 is created, ping here and I'll escalate if needed.
Samir Patel: LEGAL-4321 created and assigned to Priya. Attached customer's email with the deadline.
Priya Singh: Reviewing now, we'll aim to have an attestation draft in 2-3 business days then hand off to security for sign-off.
Marta Lopez: Customer replied that they'll sign the NDA tonight.
Julia Chen: Great — I'll update once it's countersigned and we can push the redacted SOC2 + attestation. (reaction: :thumbsup: )
